title: Studio Interfaces: an object nav entry without its own label is titled by the object's machine name in the item header ("repairs_repair_ticket · Object") while the rail shows the object label
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The scaffolded nav entry (`{type:"object", objectName}`) has no label; the header falls back to the name instead of resolving the object label as the rail does. Label-less groups show ids like "NAV_ITEM_2".

## Reproduction

1. Create an app from Studio scaffolding over an object → open its nav entry → header reads "repairs_repair_ticket · Object", rail reads "Repair Ticket".

## Expected

The header resolves the same label the rail shows (object label, then name).

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~4548 renders `current.label || current.name`.

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the coordinator and the Interfaces QA card.
- Business reason: Machine names leak into the builder for every scaffolded app.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p3.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Interfaces header shows object machine name instead of label for nav entry without label` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 8 hits, none about the Studio item header (nearest closed #25901 console labels).
- QA id: U15
